$comment: The scenarios of the title screen (scripts/game/scenarios.js). The ids are a contract: story events (P5) and saves key by them. order = position in the menu. map = { seed } plus any setting of data/map.json to override for this scenario only. start = coins, stock (units by good id, on top of data/economy.json start) and day (the game starts on that day of the first year: 20 is the first day of autumn). goals = 2 to 4 of kind population (villagers), coins (coins in the bank) or produced_in_season (units of `good` made within one season; the count starts again with each season). A goal reached stays reached. The names and blurbs are the locale strings scenario.<id>.name and .blurb; a goal's text is built from goal.<kind>. The targets are tuned to what the bot (scripts/game/bot.js) reaches, see tests/scenarios.test.js.
